headline:
تسريح ثلث العاملين
في مطورة Civilization
label: تقرير
bed_reason: trailer sound is not verified as a music-only stretch; our bed under every line
spoken: تسرّح فيراكسيس (Firaxis)، مطورة Civilization وXCOM، نحو 60 موظفًا، أي ثلث العاملين فيها، حسب بلومبرغ (Bloomberg). وأكد متحدث باسم 2K مغادرة هيذر هازن (Heather Hazen) من رئاسة الاستوديو. وذكرت بلومبرغ أن لعبة XCOM الجديدة تعثرت وفاتها موعد مهم، لكن تطويرها مستمر.

angle.hook: A third of Firaxis, the studio behind Civilization and XCOM, about 60 people, is laid off and its studio head leaves.
angle.why_now: Bloomberg reported it on 17 November, two days before GTA VI launches from the same parent company Take-Two, and 2K confirmed the restructuring and the departure of the studio head.
angle.what_it_means_here: Players waiting for the new XCOM should expect delays: Bloomberg says it missed a milestone this summer, while 2K says development continues and Firaxis keeps its focus on strategy games.
angle.limit: Bloomberg's figures are reported, not confirmed by 2K; 2K confirmed only the restructuring and the head's departure; no new release date or cancellation.
